pricing.title: Choose the right plan for you

1.a: Yes! The Free plan lets you list up to 20 products at no cost, with no credit card required. It's the simplest way to start your digital storefront. When your store grows and you need more features, just upgrade to a paid plan with one click.

2.q: Do I need a credit card to get started?
2.a: No. You can create your store and explore the platform with no initial commitment.

3.q: Is there a fee on sales?
3.a: We never charge commission on your sales. You only pay for your chosen plan.

4.q: Does it work for any niche?
4.a: Yes. Fashion, footwear, cosmetics, food, services, home decor... the platform is flexible and adapts to your business.

5.a: The system automatically tracks the quantity of each product. You get alerts when stock is low, you can block sales of out-of-stock items, and the system reserves cart items for 15 minutes to prevent duplicate sales.

6.q: Can I use my own domain?
6.a: Yes. On any paid plan you can connect your custom domain (e.g. www.mystore.com) with free SSL. Just point the DNS and the system verifies it automatically.

7.q: Does the API work with Bling, Tiny and other ERPs?
7.a: Yes. The REST API integrates with any system that supports HTTP requests. You can sync products, inventory, orders and coupons with ERPs like Bling, Tiny and others.

8.a: Yes. You can create coupons with a percentage or fixed-amount discount, set a usage limit, expiration date and minimum purchase amount. Great for promotional campaigns and customer retention.

9.a: Every user gets a unique referral link. Anyone who signs up through your link gets a discount on their first subscription, and you earn cash commissions for every converted referral. Earnings can be withdrawn directly from the dashboard.

10.q: Can I cancel at any time?
10.a: Yes. Cancellation is immediate and hassle-free, directly from the admin dashboard.
